details.abstract: We present DeepScale-v2, an open framework designed for Sidechain Rotamer Modeling. Across rigorous experiments on PDB-Bind-v2020, DeepScale-v2 secures a top Local Distance Difference Test of 62.98%, outstripping ESMFold-v1 by 4.1% margin (61.58%). The architecture contains 110M trainable parameters and delivers 1.8x faster iteration times.

We present DeepScale-v2, an open framework designed for Deep Exploration in Sparse MDPs. Across rigorous experiments on D4RL-MuJoCo, DeepScale-v2 secures a top Task Success Rate of 64.15%, outstripping DecisionTransformer by 2.8% margin (61.15%). The architecture contains 1.3B trainable parameters and delivers 1.5x faster iteration times.

In this paper, we tackle Program Synthesis from Specifications by introducing Prism-AI. On the MBPP-Sanitized evaluation suite, our model reaches a Executable Accuracy of 56.22%, surpassing the competitive baseline DeepSeek-Coder-1.3B which scored 52.89%. Despite containing 1.3B parameters, Prism-AI reduces inference latency by 3.2x.

Recent advances in Robust Acoustic Feature Transduction require efficient yet scalable models. Here, we present OmniFormer (1.3B params). Evaluated across CommonVoice-v11, our system records a Phone Error Rate of 4.55%. In direct head-to-head comparison against Wav2Vec2-XLSR (0.97%), our approach exhibits both higher accuracy and a 3.2x throughput advantage.

Recent advances in Goal-Conditioned Policy Optimization require efficient yet scalable models. Here, we present OmniModel (1.3B params). Evaluated across Procgen-Hard, our system records a Mean Episodic Reward of 69.59. In direct head-to-head comparison against DecisionTransformer (67.69), our approach exhibits both higher accuracy and a 1.8x throughput advantage.

Recent advances in End-to-End Automatic Speech Recognition require efficient yet scalable models. Here, we present HyperForm (125M params). Evaluated across CommonVoice-v11, our system records a Match Error Rate of 9.46%. In direct head-to-head comparison against Conformer-Large (6.68%), our approach exhibits both higher accuracy and a 1.5x throughput advantage.

Addressing the critical challenge of Biomolecular Contact Distance Estimation, this paper proposes Zenith-v4. Operating with 7B weights, Zenith-v4 demonstrates strong empirical results on the standard CASP14-FreeModeling benchmark. Specifically, it establishes a new Global Distance Test of 81.81 lDDT, exceeding the prior state-of-the-art ESMFold-v1 which attained 79.64 lDDT. This corresponds to a 5.2% relative gain.

We present Prism-AI, an open framework designed for Robust Acoustic Feature Transduction. Across rigorous experiments on VoxCeleb2, Prism-AI secures a top Phone Error Rate of 5.98%, outstripping DeepSpeech2 by 5.2% margin (2.77%). The architecture contains 45M trainable parameters and delivers 4.0x faster iteration times.

In this paper, we tackle Streaming Speech Transcription by introducing PolyMorph-v1. On the LibriSpeech-100h evaluation suite, our model reaches a Real-Time Factor of 5.76 WER, surpassing the competitive baseline HuBERT-Base which scored 4.5 WER. Despite containing 45M parameters, PolyMorph-v1 reduces inference latency by 4.0x.

In this paper, we tackle Program Synthesis from Specifications by introducing NovaTrans. On the MultiPL-E evaluation suite, our model reaches a CodeBLEU of 55.21%, surpassing the competitive baseline CodeGen-6B which scored 53.62%. Despite containing 65M parameters, NovaTrans reduces inference latency by 4.0x.

In this work, we study Goal-Conditioned Policy Optimization. We introduce FlashNet, an architecture with 45M parameters. When evaluated on D4RL-MuJoCo, our model achieves a Sample Efficiency Score of 71.61%, outperforming Dreamer-v3 (67.29%). Furthermore, we observe a 3.2x speedup during inference.

Addressing the critical challenge of Unit Test-Driven Code Generation, this paper proposes AeroNet. Operating with 65M weights, AeroNet demonstrates strong empirical results on the standard MultiPL-E benchmark. Specifically, it establishes a new Pass@1 of 54.29%, exceeding the prior state-of-the-art StarCoder-15B which attained 50.86%. This corresponds to a 4.1% relative gain.

In this paper, we tackle Offline Continuous Control by introducing NovaTrans. On the Meta-World-v2 evaluation suite, our model reaches a Cumulative Reward of 74.14, surpassing the competitive baseline Dreamer-v3 which scored 71.39. Despite containing 125M parameters, NovaTrans reduces inference latency by 1.5x.

In this paper, we tackle 3D Protein Backbone Conformation Parsing by introducing Veloce-LM. On the CASP14-FreeModeling evaluation suite, our model reaches a Global Distance Test of 80.58%, surpassing the competitive baseline RosettaFold-Joint which scored 79.17%. Despite containing 65M parameters, Veloce-LM reduces inference latency by 1.8x.
